column1: # Ondra, the Tideglass Queen, in Tolbi.

column3: Three kind hands, three\nshards of tide. Who wakes\nthe Queen of the Deep?{end_wait}
Who are you? You look\nlike Mia.{end_wait}

I am Ondra. I drowned a
kingdom to keep it safe.{page_break}The blade remembers me.
Show me you are not
fools.{end_wait}
I did not come to fight\nyou. But I will not run.{end_wait}
